terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && export PYTHONPATH=$PWD && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir $PWD

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd frontend && export NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8000/api/v1 NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 && npm run dev

terminals.name: celery-worker
terminals.command: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && export PYTHONPATH=$PWD && celery -A app.celery_app.celery worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2

terminals.name: celery-beat
terminals.command: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && export PYTHONPATH=$PWD && celery -A app.celery_app.celery beat --loglevel=info --schedule ../.localdata/celerybeat-schedule
